name: io.github.yaboom/listguard
title: ListGuard — Listing Compliance Audit
description: Deterministic compliance audit for cross-border e-commerce listings (Amazon, Temu, TikTok Shop). Detects banned words, promo words, absolute claims, unsupported certification claims, trademark risks and missing AI content disclosure (2026-08 Amazon rule). Versioned YAML rule packs, three-level obfuscation-resistant matching, no LLM involved in judging — every finding carries a rule id and rationale.
